title.zh: 金融與專業服務人才招募｜財會、法遵、風控與法務｜HiReKing
title.en: Financial & Professional Services Recruitment | Finance, Compliance, Risk & Legal | HiReKing

desc.zh: HiReKing 金融與專業服務獵才：會計、財務、法遵、風控、法務與顧問職，重視證照條件與背景查核，並支援科技與製造業的財會法務團隊擴編。
desc.en: HiReKing recruits across accounting, finance, compliance, risk, legal and advisory roles — with proper attention to credentials and background checks, including finance and legal build-outs inside technology and manufacturing firms.

sub.zh: 證照、資歷與背景查核在這個領域不是形式。我們逐項確認，因為錯一次的代價由你承擔。
sub.en: Credentials, track record and background checks are not a formality here. We verify them item by item, because you carry the cost of getting it wrong.

bullets.zh: 財務長、財務經理與財會主管
財務分析、預算與管理會計
合併報表、IFRS 與集團財務
法令遵循、洗錢防制與 KYC
風險管理與信用風險分析
bullets.en: Risk management and credit risk analysis

bullets.zh: 企業法務、合約審閱與商務談判
bullets.en: In-house counsel, contract review and commercial negotiation

bullets.zh: 智慧財產、專利佈局與訴訟支援
bullets.en: IP, patent strategy and litigation support

title.zh: 科技公司也在搶這批人
title.en: Technology firms are competing for these people too

body.zh:
半導體與科技製造公司在擴張期，最常見的隱形瓶頸不是工程師，是財會與法遵團隊跟不上。上市櫃申報、跨國移轉訂價、海外據點的稅務與合約——這些職缺的人選來源是金融業與會計師事務所，不是同業。

我們同時看這兩塊，所以能把四大出身的財會人才、金融業的法遵專才，接到科技公司的職缺上，並且講得清楚兩邊在工作型態與薪酬結構上的差異。
body.en:
In semiconductor and manufacturing firms that are scaling, the hidden bottleneck is rarely engineers — it is that finance and compliance cannot keep up. Listing requirements, cross-border transfer pricing, tax and contracts for overseas sites: the people who do this come from banking and the accounting firms, not from your competitors.

Because we cover both markets, we can bring Big Four finance talent and banking compliance specialists into technology roles — and explain honestly how the work and the pay structure differ on each side.

title.zh: 背景查核我們做到哪裡

items.zh: 證照真實性與有效期間確認（會計師、律師、CIA、CFA 等）
items.en: Verifying licences and their validity — CPA, bar admission, CIA, CFA and others

items.zh: 學歷與任職經歷的逐項核對
items.en: Item-by-item verification of education and employment history

items.zh: 離職原因與可揭露的前雇主評價（經人選同意）
items.en: Reasons for leaving and referenceable feedback from previous employers, with the candidate's consent

items.zh: 競業與保密義務的存續狀況
items.en: Any live non-compete or confidentiality obligations

title.zh: 要找的是能扛責任的人
title.en: You need someone who can carry the responsibility

body.zh: 這類職缺找錯人的成本不只是重招，而是實質的合規風險。我們寧可多花兩週，也不推不確定的人選。
body.en: A bad hire here costs more than a re-run of the search — it is real compliance exposure. We would rather take two more weeks than present a candidate we are unsure about.
